news_list.title: Revival 0.2.0
news_list.short_description: Bags, real weather, a working What's new and a lighter server.
news_list.content:
What changed in this update:
- Bags are back: Thorstein sells five (Equipment tab), from 50 to 400 more inventory slots. A full bag leaves fight loot behind.
- Real weather where you play, from Open-Meteo.
- Add Station in the Alchemy tab lists the stations again.
- This What's new page loads, and shows each update's notes.
- The game server and the map use far less memory, so reloading a big region no longer closes the game.
- Monsters line the streets of towns, not just their parks, and are spread over paths, parks, woods and water instead of filling whichever park or wood is nearest. A map cell can hold more places and up to 36 monsters.
- Walking dailies pay when you claim them.
- Wolven armor shows its real bonus.
- The companion's dashboard has a Tuning page: monsters, places, experience, loot, herbs, nest gold, bag size and weather.
- Send a report in the companion app makes one zip with every log, for bug reports.
